spans.s: (a-ghya) (Gr.) other than the suffix ghya(ṇ) (= P. ण्यत्) क्षेरघ्ये ŚākaṭāVyā. iv. 1. 252 (comm. घ्यण्प्रत्ययस्यार्थो भावकर्मणी ततोऽन्यत्र; cf. iv. 3. 60)
(aghy-ac) (Gr.) the vowel except (in the beginning of) the first five case suffixes (viz. su, au, jas, am, and au) अघ्यच्ताच्येप् पिः
(a-ghyādi) adj. (suffixes) other than ghya(ṇ) etc. (see ŚākaṭāVyā. iv. 3. 60 to iv. 4. 186) न सप्तम्यघ्यादिषु ŚākaṭāVyā. i. 1. 57.
(a-ghyārtha) m. meaning other than the one expressed by the kṛt suffix ghya(ṇ) (see SiddhaHe. v. 1. 7) क्षेः क्षी चाघ्यार्थे SiddhaHe. iv. 2. 74.
